University of Kashmir
South Campus (NAAC Accredited Grade “A”++)
High ground, Fatehghar Anantnag-192101 Jammu &Kashmir
Interview Notice
This is to inform that the interview for the position of Research Assistant and Field
Investigator under the ICSSR sponsored research project entitled “Cognitive and Behavioral
Drivers of UPI-linked Credit Usage and Financial Well-being: Evidences from the UT of
Jammu & Kashmir" undertaken by the Department of Management Studies, University of
Kashmir (South Campus), will be held on 30.06.2026 (Tuesday) from10:30 AM onwards in
the Office of the Direct South Campus, University of Kashmir. Applicants are required to
bring all the original documents, research publications, CV and one set of photocopies of
documents along with them for interview.
Sd/
Project Director
No. F(Project)DMS/SC/KU/26
